@everyone, we’ve received reports that accounts within the community are being targeted and compromised. Your account security is extremely important, and we strongly urge everyone to take immediate action to protect themselves. Here’s what you should do RIGHT NOW: 🔒 Enable 2-Step Verification (2FA) This adds an extra layer of security. Even if someone gets your password, they won’t be able to access your account without your verification code. To add 2 step verification, go to your account security settings, and toggle "Email (Secure)", or for more security "Authenticator App (Very Secure)" 📧 Add and Verify Your Email Address Make sure your email is connected to your account and verified. This helps you recover your account if anything happens. 📱 Link Your Phone Number Adding a phone number gives you another recovery option and improves overall account security. 🔑 Use a Strong, Unique Password Avoid reusing passwords from other sites. Make it long, random, and hard to guess. ⚠️ DO NOT click suspicious links or download unknown files Most account breaches happen through phishing. If something looks off, it probably is. If you notice something unusual, or you have suspicions that your account has been compromised, tell us immediately. Stay safe, – K1LL Higher Ups
